dict.string: SightSense sends the camera picture and LiDAR depth to the GX10 to find obstacles and objects.
SightSense sends camera frames to the GX10 on the team's local network.
SightSense uses your location and heading to follow walking routes.
SightSense listens while you hold the talk button so you can say where to go.
SightSense turns your spoken command into text on the phone.
